entities.name: Hans-Joachim Born
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans-Joachim Born, was a German radiochemist and a professor of chemistry at the Technical University of Munich who was one of the senior German nuclear scientists in the Soviet program of nuclear weapons, and later his research was used in the Soviet program of biological weapons.
